Supreme Court Bar Association condemns litigant's abusive conduct

The Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA) has condemned the abusive conduct of a litigant within the Supreme Court premises. The SCBA has also requested the formulation of guidelines regarding the circulation of courtroom proceedings to uphold the dignity of the court.
